messages:
kevin: Hey team — pushed updates to PR #4392 (batching refactor + integration test + metrics cleanup). Need one approval before we slot this into the canary window tomorrow morning. Diff: https://git/repo/pull/4392

maria: scanning now, should have quick notes in ~30m

sasha: quick question: why move the batch timer to 5ms? seems low, worried about extra small batches.

kevin: good call — moved to 5ms only for low-latency path behind feature flag. added comment in batch_manager explaining rationale and a flag to revert. perf note: ~12% p95 reduction on our rtx-a workload when enabled.

maria: left two tiny nits (metrics name + docstring). also suggest adding a short smoke script for manual checks.

kevin: addressed those nits and added scripts/smoke_batch.sh. pushed a force-update to the branch.

bot-ci: CI: triggered rerun by kevin — unit tests running (build 483).

sasha: CI looks green for the parts I care about. lgtm assuming the flaky test is unrelated. can you squash the fixup commits? prefer a single commit for canary history.

kevin: squashed into one commit and force-pushed. CI rerun started. the flaky integration test failed previously but that's unrelated; rerun now.

bot-ci: CI: build 484 passed all unit and integration tests.

maria: approved.

sasha: approved :shipit:  — leaving a short comment about reverting the flag if we see regressions.

mike-oncall: noted for oncall — I'll watch the canary and slack if I see spikes. schedule OK for 03:00 PT?

kevin: scheduling 03:00 PT canary, will tag the deploy and set the rollout to 5% then 25. rollout.yaml pinned to v1.7.3. rollback target set to v1.7.2.

maria: perfect. resolving this thread — thanks all.

kevin: thanks! ping me if anything pops during the canary.
